title: Part Search Spec
description: Input specification for a parametric part search against the Nexar/Octopart API

q.description: Keyword query string passed as the top-level search term (e.g. 'resistor', 'LM358')

category.description: Human-readable category name (informational only, not sent to API)

category_id.description: Octopart/Nexar numeric category ID — required to scope the search

distributors.description: Return only parts with at least one offer from any of these distributors. Use Nexar display names (e.g. 'Digi-Key') or numeric IDs (e.g. '459'). Results may include offers from other distributors too — filter client-side if needed.

limit.description: Maximum number of parts to return per page

start.description: Pagination offset — index of the first result to return

manufacturers.description: Return only parts made by any of these manufacturers. Use Nexar display names (e.g. 'Yageo', 'Vishay').

in_stock.description: If true, return only parts with stock > 0 at one or more of the specified distributors (or any distributor if none specified)

has_datasheet.description: If true, return only parts that have at least one datasheet URL

lifecycle_status.description: Return only parts with one of these lifecycle statuses. Omit to return all statuses. Common values: Active, NRND (Not Recommended for New Designs), Obsolete.

sort.description: Field to sort results by. Omit entirely to use Nexar's default relevance ranking. Explicit options: median_price_1, median_price_10, median_price_100, median_price_1000, best_datasheet, factory_lead_days.

sort_direction.description: Sort order. Only applies when sort is specified.

parameters.description: Technical attribute filters. Keys must be valid Nexar attribute shortnames for the target category (e.g. 'resistance', 'tolerance', 'case_package'). All values must be strings — quote numeric values. Valid shortnames per category are documented in data/part-category-attributes.json.

output.description: Controls which field groups are requested in the API response. Each group maps to a set of GraphQL subfields in the client. Omit output entirely to request all groups.

groups.description: Field groups to include. basic: mpn, name, description, manufacturer, category, image. specs: all parametric attributes (resistance, tolerance, etc). offers: distributor offers including SKU, inventory, MOQ, pack size, and full price-break ladder. datasheet: document URLs. lifecycle: active/NRND/obsolete status. cad: CAD model availability flags — ECAD symbol, footprint, 3D model (Enterprise only). compliance: RoHS and other compliance flags (higher tiers only).
